maker: Takenaka Corporation, Kajima Corporation and AKTIO Corporation
variant: tower crane remote operation system with ground cockpits
name: TawaRemo tower crane remote operation
summary: Remote operation system for tower cranes developed in 2020 by Takenaka, Kajima and the rental company AKTIO: the operator works from a cockpit on the ground instead of climbing to the crane cab, and several cockpits can sit side by side for training. Used on Japanese building sites and shared with members of the Construction RX Consortium.

germany.statusNote: Available in Japan to Takenaka and the member companies of the Construction RX Consortium (291 companies in May 2025). Use abroad is only being considered, in Asian countries such as South Korea. No European route found.

specs.label: Machine
specs.value: tower cranes, operated from the ground
specs.quote: we began developing a system that allows tower cranes to be operated remotely from the ground

specs.label: Operation
specs.value: same feel as the crane cab; delay between controls and crane movement kept low
specs.quote: We ensured that the operation would feel the same as conventional tower cranes and implemented measures to minimize the delay between the control interface and the actual movement of the tower crane.

specs.label: Cockpits
specs.value: several cockpits can be placed in the same location so one experienced operator can instruct several young operators
specs.quote: TawaRemo allows multiple cockpits to be placed in the same location

specs.label: Who can use it
specs.value: Takenaka and member companies of the Construction RX Consortium
specs.quote: TawaRemo is currently available not only to our company but also to member companies of the Construction RX Consortium

notes: Remote operation of a stationary tower crane; the crane hook is the tool. Load capacity depends on the crane.
Removes the climb of up to 50 m to the crane cab; operators can work from the ground all day.
